description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Cost 1 Vitae

Duration until the end of the scene

Cut yourself resistance to one damage type for the rest of the scene.

Choose one damage type you have been damaged by since your last daily preparations. Gain resistance to it equal to half your level for the duration.

cinderfall.incomplete: This is an activated, duration-limited self-buff shaped exactly like this corpus's own 13 companion-effect pairs (apex-draught -> apex-draught-effect, etc.) and the real pf2e precedent for that shape (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/equipment/juggernaut-mutagen-lesser.json + equipment-effects/effect-juggernaut-mutagen-lesser.json; feats/class/monk/level-1/gorilla-stance.json + feat-effects/stance-gorilla-stance.json) -- in both, the triggering card's rules: [] is correct and the numeric payload lives on a separate companion Effect item the triggering card GrantItems into. No matching *-effect.json companion exists for this card, so the mechanism is real but the sibling file it would need is missing -- a card-authoring gap, not an engine limitation. Even setting that aside, no selector anywhere in pf2e-source tracks "a damage type this actor was damaged by since its last daily preparations" -- that is game-state history no rule element records.
